Next.js 16 App Router club-management system for TJ Sokol Svinov (Czech handball club). Stack: TypeScript strict, Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth), TanStack Query v5, HeroUI v2, Tailwind CSS v4, Vitest. UI language is **Czech** — all user-facing strings must be in Czech.

Use skills in `.claude/skills/` proactively:
- `/new-entity` whenever adding a database table, data model, or CRUD feature. Do not scaffold files manually; invoke this skill.
- `/db-sync` after any DB migration is applied or when TypeScript types are out of sync with the database schema.
- `/new-migration` whenever a new table, column, function, view, or RLS policy needs to be created in the database.
- `/generate-barrels` after adding, renaming, or removing any hook, component, type, or enum file. Run before committing.
- `/review-pr` for code review, PR review, or "check my changes".
Follow these patterns strictly. Do not deviate without explicit user instruction.

Entity layout:
`src/types/entities/{camelCase}/schema/{camelCase}Schema.ts` (AUTO-GENERATED, do not edit manually), `data/{camelCase}.ts` (domain types extending schema);
`src/queries/{pluralCamel}/constants.ts` (DB_TABLE + ENTITY), `queries.ts` (read; QueryContext), `mutations.ts` (write; QueryContext), `index.ts` (barrel);
`src/hooks/entities/{kebab-case}/data/useFetch{Entity}s.ts` (createDataFetchHook factory), `state/use{Entity}.ts` (createCRUDHook factory);
`src/lib/translations/{pluralCamel}.ts` (Czech strings).

| Context | Use |
|---|---|
| Client/browser | `supabaseBrowserClient()` from `@/utils/supabase/client` |
| Server component | `supabaseServerClient()` from `@/utils/supabase/server` |
| Authenticated API | `withAuth(handler)` from `@/utils/supabase/apiHelpers` |
| Admin API | `withAdminAuth(handler)` from `@/utils/supabase/apiHelpers` |
| Public API | `withPublicAccess(handler)` from `@/utils/supabase/apiHelpers` |
| Coach checks | `hasCoachRole()` / `isAdmin()` / `checkCoachCardAccess()` from `@/utils/supabase/coachAuth` |

Never import a server client in a client component or vice versa.
Prefer `apiHelpers` wrappers over calling `supabaseServerClient()` directly in API routes — they handle auth, 401/403, and error responses consistently.
All query/mutation functions in `src/queries/` receive `ctx: QueryContext` as first argument and use `ctx.supabase`. Never call the Supabase client directly inside query files.

These files are **auto-generated** — never edit manually, always regenerate:
`src/hooks/index.ts`, `src/types/index.ts`, `src/components/index.ts`.
These files are **manual** — always update by hand:
`src/lib/api-routes.ts`, `src/lib/translations/index.ts`.

Use layout components instead of raw Tailwind flex/grid classes: `Grid`, `GridItem`, `HStack`, `VStack` from `@/components`. Tailwind CSS does not support dynamic class construction (e.g. `` `flex-${direction}` ``). All layout components use static lookup maps to generate classes. Follow this pattern when creating new layout components.
Responsive grids: `<Grid columns={3} gap="md">`; spanning: `<GridItem span={2}>`; rows: `<HStack spacing={2}>`; columns: `<VStack spacing={4}>`.
Files: `src/components/ui/Grid/Grid.tsx`, `src/components/ui/Grid/components/GridItem.tsx`, `src/components/ui/HStack/HStack.tsx`, `src/components/ui/VStack/VStack.tsx`, `src/components/ui/Stack/Stack.tsx` (base).
Do not use manual `grid grid-cols-...`, `col-span-X`, `<div className="flex gap-2">`, `<div className="flex flex-col gap-4">`, or `space-y-X`.
